source_clocks.disclosure_rule: every artifact states the oldest input date beside the result

public_surface.rule: READY does not authorize public promotion. PUBLIC_ROWS stays empty and display_ready stays false until a separate owner approval.

rule.rule: abs(Base(g_low)/Base(g_base) - 1) <= 0.20 and abs(Base(g_high)/Base(g_base) - 1) <= 0.20, for both indices
rule.note: g_high is clamped by the Rf cap and therefore sits 65 basis points above g_base rather than 100. This is the cap doing its job, not a widened gate.
rule.replaces: the old E5 F2 discontinuous sign-flip-around-spot gate, which could fail merely because a valuation sat near fair value. The old F2 result is preserved unaltered in the historical-validation record and is not erased.
